name: Bartholomew
overview: Bartholomew is identified in Scripture as one of the twelve apostles chosen by Jesus, consistently listed alongside other key disciples such as Philip, Thomas, and Matthew in the Gospels of Matthew, Mark, and Luke, as well as in the book of Acts. These passages emphasize Bartholomew's integral role within the foundational group of Christ’s followers who were present during significant moments, including their gathering in the upper room after Jesus' resurrection. His inclusion in these lists underscores his participation in the early apostolic ministry and the spread of the Gospel.
